jobs.description:
Director, Renewals & Quoting Strategy & Operations

Rubrik is on a mission to secure and accelerate the world's AI transformation. Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. With Zero Trust Data Security™, Rubrik helps organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions.

About the Team

Rubrik's Renewals & Quoting Strategy & Operations team sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, translating go-to-market priorities into the operational infrastructure that drives predictable, scalable business outcomes.

The team spans renewal operations and quoting, and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Product so that every renewal and new business deal is handled with speed, accuracy, and strategic intent. We're a high-impact team in a period of active build, which means the work is visible, the problems are real, and there's a genuine opportunity to shape how this function grows.

As the Director of Renewals & Quoting Strategy, you will be the senior-most leader of our India team and a strategic right hand to the Senior Director of Global Renewals & Quoting Operations. You will take our India-based Renewal Operations, Data Assurance and Quote Desk teams to the next level of scale, rigor, and impact.. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting, strategy, or operations background who wants to own solutions in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

What You Will Do

Build the Foundations of the Renewals Business

Design and implement the systems, policies, and processes that enable renewals to scale, with clear rules of engagement, strong governance, and a great experience for sales and customers.

Develop quoting frameworks and standards for multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion scenarios that maximize ARR retention.

Partner with IT, RevOps, and Finance to define requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and automation.

Create playbooks, guidelines, and standard operating procedures that make excellence repeatable across regions.

Evolve and Lead Our Data Quality Function

Define the next chapter for the team responsible for the accuracy and integrity of the data powering global renewals operations, supporting a large global base of account executives and renewal sales professionals.

Raise the standard of the function through clear data definitions, quality metrics, audit rhythms, and governance controls across CRM and renewal systems.

Shift the team from reactive clean-up to proactive, preventive, and increasingly automated data quality.

Turn data insights into action for sales leadership, and partner with Business Intelligence so reporting meets business needs.

Lead the Quote Desk Center of Excellence

Own the strategy, service standards, and quality bar of our India-based Quote Desk, which serves sales teams worldwide, and scale it into a recognized center of excellence.

Drive adoption of the Quote Desk and build trusted relationships with the sales leaders who rely on it.

Streamline end-to-end workflows from opportunity identification to quote to close, reducing cycle times and improving accuracy.

Influence and Partner Across the Business

Partner with India renewals sales leadership and senior stakeholders across Sales and Finance globally, bringing structure, data, and a clear point of view.

Navigate high-stakes conversations and competing priorities with poise, and align leaders around trade-offs and decisions.

Present renewal performance, forecasts, and operational insights to senior leadership in partnership with the Senior Director.

Build and Inspire the Team

Attract and hire exceptional talent, and set a higher bar for what great looks like across roles.

Coach and develop high-potential people into future leaders, building clear career paths and strong succession.

Raise the overall caliber, capability, and culture of the India team over time.

Desired Skills & Experience

Required

12+ years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, Sales/Renewal Operations, or Business Operations, ideally within a high-growth technology or SaaS business.

5+ years of people leadership, including hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or transforming an operations, data quality, or shared-services team that supports a large sales organization, including raising talent quality and operating standards.

Experience setting up or scaling a center of excellence in India, including driving adoption and stakeholder buy-in.

Proven ability to influence senior sales and finance leaders across geographies, including through difficult conversations and pushback.

Thrives in ambiguity, with exceptional prioritization and problem-solving skills and a high degree of ownership and autonomy.

Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and presentation), with the ability to simplify complexity for any audience.

Strong analytical skills, with experience driving insight through tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Salesforce, or Clari.

Strong project management skills, including defining and executing against timelines, dependencies, and risks.

B.A./B.S. degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree highly preferred.

Preferred

Experience with CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) and/or forecasting platforms such as Clari.

Familiarity with renewal quoting workflows, including multi-year and co-term deal structures.

Understanding of SaaS renewal metrics: ARR, NRR, GRR, churn rate, renewal rate, and pipeline coverage.

Exposure to subscription lifecycle management, contract data, and revenue recognition concepts.

Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and ad hoc analysis.

Why this role: If you're ready to take real ownership of execution, with a seat at the table, a team to build, and a business to shape, this is that opportunity.

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Role 

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant – Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid (work location: Mohali / Bangalore) role, reporting to the Manager , Professional Services in the Professional Services (Solution Consulting) department. Sitting at the intersection of strategic enterprise consulting and forward-deployed engineering, you will serve as the primary technical authority and end-to-end delivery owner for our enterprise DSPM customers across financial services, public sector, retail, SaaS, and beyond. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and sprawling multi-cloud data estates, you will turn complexity into clarity. You will architect, deploy, and optimize DSPM solutions alongside the broader Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform—driving expanded cloud-estate visibility, accurate sensitive-data inventory, reduced identity and credential exposure, and AI governance. Beyond traditional consulting, this role requires strong hands-on technical depth: you will configure complex data connectors, customize data classification pipelines, resolve production-level identity and integration challenges, and bridge real-world customer deployments directly with Core Engineering and Product Management.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

Own the Technical Lifecycle & Solution Architecture: Serve as the primary technical leader for named enterprise accounts, designing and executing complex, highly regulated DSPM deployments across multi-cloud, hybrid, and air-gapped environments.

Drive Ecosystem Integration & Strategic Outcomes: Integrate DSPM capabilities seamlessly with ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange to deliver measurable security value, including sensitive-data discovery, shadow AI risk reduction, and over-privileged access remediation.

Lead High-Touch Executive & Technical Engagements: Conduct strategic workshops, technical discoveries, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), translating complex technical findings into actionable, executive-grade risk summaries and security roadmaps.

Execute Hands-On Data, Identity, & Workflow Engineering: Configure data connectors across major public clouds and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery), manage enterprise identity/IAM permissions, and build downstream SIEM/ticketing integrations.

Unblock Deployments & Shape Product Roadmap: Partner with Core Engineering to resolve complex production escalations, support pre-sales/POV engagements, and translate customer feedback into prioritized platform improvements.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

Thrive in ambiguity, navigating dynamic environments with confidence to build clear paths forward and transform complex challenges into structured, impactful solutions.

Act like an owner, bringing an intrinsic bias for action and accountability while moving seamlessly between high-level strategy and detailed technical execution.

Problem-solver at core, energized by tackling complex architectural hurdles and committed to delivering high-impact, practical solutions.

High-trust collaborator, dedicated to collective team success and fostering a culture of open, candid feedback to build enduring trust across sales and delivery organizations.

Customer-obsessed mindset, maintaining deep empathy for internal and external stakeholders to anchor every architectural recommendation in real-world customer success.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Over 8 years of experience in high-impact, customer-facing roles (Professional Services, Architecture Consulting, TAM, or Escalation Engineering) successfully managing and securing enterprise-level accounts.

Proven expertise deploying advanced security and data solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with hands-on administration of modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and corporate document systems.

Deep specialization in Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), data classification/DLP pipelines, and securing cutting-edge LLM/API-driven workloads against shadow AI risks.

Comprehensive technical command of modern identity frameworks (SAML, SSO, OAuth2, SCIM, IAM), enterprise networking (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS), and robust Zero Trust security architectures.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience leveraging AI & Technical Coding Depth, ability to integrate artificial intelligence solutions while retaining the technical depth to read, debug, and contribute targeted code or automation scripts within backend services, APIs, and data pipelines (leveraging Python, SQL, REST APIs, Elasticsearch, MySQL, or Redis).

Zero Trust, SASE, & SecOps Ecosystem Expertise, hands-on experience deploying and operating Zscaler solutions (\ZIA, \ZPA, \ZDX) or equivalent SASE/SSE platforms across large-scale enterprise environments, alongside a proven track record of integrating security tools with SIEM/SOAR/ITSM workflows (Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, Teams, Salesforce) and designing architectures for strict regulatory compliance (\FedRAMP, \PCI-DSS, \HIPAA, \GDPR).

Pre-Sales Leadership, POV Execution, & Credentials, proven capability in leading technical proofs-of-value (POVs), building scalable demo environments, and translating evaluations into customer adoption, backed by industry-standard credentials (such as \ZDTA/\ZDTE, \CISSP, \CCSP, or AWS/Azure/GCP cloud certifications).

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior UX Researcher

Role Located out of: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

The Overview

At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.

In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.

Finer Print

You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design & Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.

You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.

What You Will Do

As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.

Own Access Management Research in India: Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

Build an Exclusive User Panel: Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.

Pioneer AI-Driven Efficiency: Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.

Make Research a "Team Sport": Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.

Exercise Methodological Rigor: Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.

Drive Global Alignment & Storytelling: Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

Technical Research Expertise: Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer-facing domains.

Strategic & Autonomous Thinker: Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.

AI Tooling & Practice: Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time-to-insight without compromising rigor.

Global Collaboration: Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.

Systems & Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.

Growth Mindset & Empathy: Strong self-awareness, receptiveness to feedback, and passion for solving high-stakes identity and security problems.

Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of product development experience conducting UX research in enterprise/B2B product environments, OR a Master’s degree/PhD in HCI, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, or related field with 2+ years of experience.

Portfolio: A digital portfolio or case study deck demonstrating end to end research ownership, complex technical problem spaces, generative and evaluative methodologies, and measurable business/product impact.

Platform Knowledge: Experience researching desktop and mobile applications across macOS, Windows, iOS, or Android environments.

Security Context: Background in identity, access management, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT admin tools is a strong plus.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

You will combine deep SaaS GTM domain knowledge with experience defining decision-grade signals for direct sellers, and partner with engineering to bring them to life as AI agents. In this role, you will identify where reps and sales leaders need real-time signals, and work with engineering to build and prioritize the roadmap for how AI-generated signals power seller decisions across the direct sales motion.

What You'll Do (Role Expectations)

Lead business process analysis and discovery sessions with Account Executives & Sales Management to understand the current state, then articulate the future state and where AI should help.

Turn ideas into actionable, AI-powered insights and recommendations by identifying where sellers and sales leadership lack clarity, context, or preparation, and map the current seller process to pinpoint where AI should help.

Assess feasibility before building with engineering, including required data inputs and quality, business logic, dependencies, fit within existing seller workflows, and success metrics.

Write, test, and refine prompts and output formats for AI-generated content such as meeting briefs and deal summaries, and evaluate every output by whether it helps a seller or manager decide faster or better, retiring or reworking what doesn’t improve outcomes such as win rate, forecast accuracy, or rep productivity.

Monitor AI solution performance and adoption, gather seller feedback, continuously optimize output quality, reliability, and business impact, and report results to leadership to guide prioritization and investment.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

You are a strategic translator who can bridge the gap between ambiguous business needs and concrete, buildable engineering requirements

You are highly analytical and detail-oriented, taking pride in maintaining a single source of truth that drives decisions across the sales org

You are outcome-focused and execution-driven, with a track record of delivering solutions that teams actually adopt rather than just creating proof of concepts

You are an exceptional collaborator who builds strong cross-functional partnerships across Sales, RevOps, and technical engineering departments

You are a strong communicator who can translate complex data, performance metrics, and technical signals into compelling, revenue-focused narratives for leadership

What We're Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

4-7+ years of experience in a GTM analyst, RevOps, or Sales Strategy role at a B2B SaaS company, with strong domain knowledge of direct selling motions

Proven ability to translate an ambiguous seller pain point into a concrete, buildable signal specification

Track record of successfully shipping analytical solutions or processes that sellers actively adopted in production

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive operational efficiency, backed by exposure to how AI agents or models are built

Experience with multiple signal types, showing analytical range across the sales funnel

Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Dynamics

Role 

We are looking for a Business Support Analyst (L1) — LMS & AI Specialist to join our team. This is a Bangalore, India (Hybrid) role, reporting to the Manager, Business Applications Support in the IT / Digital Employee Experience department. Author, test, and maintain generative AI prompts and prompt libraries for knowledge base creation, ticket responses, and SOP generation

You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Human Resources, or 2–4 years of experience in SaaS application support or LMS administration

Working knowledge of Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) Learning module or related enterprise SaaS platforms

Hands-on experience or project work building no-code/low-code automations (Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Zapier) alongside prompt engineering proficiency to generate structured LLM outputs for support documentation and workflows

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone of Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, payroll services, operational excellence, and monetization services to Stripe.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. You'll help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts and workflows, and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

Responsibilities

Onboard sold custom contracts into our billing systems.

Work with legal contracts with strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Develop and manage scalable billing and collection processes for complex user agreements and new business operations.

Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users.

Partner with internal systems, global deal management, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineering, and accounting teams to develop and improve processes for contract reviews and to anticipate changing business requirements.

Partner with account managers to resolve user inquiries related to onboarding implementation, billing, and collections.

Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share system feedback and insights with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Legal on innovation and improvements needed to optimize the Stripe user experience.

Help scope, build, and deliver continuous process improvements that enhance operations.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

5+ years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally in customer success, consulting, financial services, account management, or sales, preferably working with technical products.

Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions.

Ability to be detail-oriented while visualizing the larger impact of a series of transactions.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate data and people to find answers.

Strong operating rigor, including organizational and time management skills.

Ability to work well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally, including working with a team of sales and services peers.

Motivation and flexibility to work well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly.

Preferred qualifications

Ability to trace process impacts from situation to end customers and business financial outcomes.

Knowledge of or experience in the payments industry.

Demonstrated professional experience using GSuite, Excel, and working with large data sets.

Experience with SQL.

Demonstrated project management or consulting experience and the ability to work cross-functionally.

A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom.

A passion for learning and solving problems through infrastructure and automation.

Strong analytical ability, proficiency with SQL (minimum of 3 years advanced SQL) and strong understanding of data relationships

Experience working with extremely large datasets

Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills

Experience working in or with Financial Services, Accounting, GTM/Sales, Operations

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As the Stripe user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand the Stripe portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an independent business, startup, SMB, or enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible.

What you'll do

You'll recruit, manage, and develop a group of Marketing Operations Associates and team leads that are focused on delivering repeatable, measurable programs and campaigns targeted on spend optimization, producing highly qualified leads, improving the customer experience, and increasing retention. You'll lead the team supporting the Stripe Marketing Operations and are comfortable jumping in to perform production duties, especially in times of need. You'll cultivate the happiness of your team members while guiding them to excel, through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and advocacy within the organization. Support Marketo workflows, performance marketing operations, and event analysis

Ensure reportability of core operations cycles

Optimize Marketing Operations processes

10+ years relevant work experience in Marketing Operations

Experience and desire for contributing to developing business infrastructure and aggressively scaling a high-growth business

jobs.title: long form content writer/editor
jobs.description:
what is CRED?

 

CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 

 

CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 

 

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. 

what will you do?

build trust in and understanding of CRED among external audiences by producing a steady body of editorial: blogs, website content, reports, and brand and product narratives that shape how people think about money, credit, and the category CRED operates in.

think like a fintech and lifestyle journalist. mine product, engineering, design, and talent teams for the details worth telling, then connect them into stories that are new, credible, and grounded in the CRED brand and its values.

own the writing end to end: point of view, structure, and line-level craft, plus the judgment to match each story to the right format (long-form report, blog, product page, founder essay, social).

hold the editorial bar for the brand across voice, rigour, and factual defensibility, so everything published under CRED reads like it came from one credible mind.

you should apply if you have:

a track record of owning and shaping narratives over the long term, not just filling a content calendar

a body of work that proves range across formats and a distinct point of view 

the ability to work across teams with different priorities and still land a coherent story

Deeply passionate about tech and has worked on long form tech content writing

background in fintech, business, or lifestyle editorial

experience writing in a founder or executive voice

ability to predict, measure, and articulate the impact of editorial against CRED's business and comms priorities

data sensibility for reports and long-form

here's what will be in store for you at CRED once you join the team.

as part of the credit card bill payments (ccbp) team at CRED, you'll be responsible for the overall growth of credit-card bill payments on the platform - the flow through which members pay their credit card bills (their own and others') via CRED. ccbp is one of the highest-frequency, highest-trust actions on the app, and directly compounds into CRED's growth and retention.

what will you do?

own key input levers of the ccbp business - acquisition and resurrection of members paying credit card bills, and multi-card adoption - deep-diving on metrics and diagnosing drop-offs to course-correct performance.

track and report on these levers daily/weekly/monthly, owning monthly planning and flagging deviations early.

exercise judgment on when to resolve issues independently vs. escalate, and anticipate recurring problem patterns before they hit the numbers.

own execution across the bill-pay funnel (discovery, reminders, payment, retry/failure), building preventive and reactive interventions to lift conversion.

translate broader category strategy into concrete campaigns, experiments, and milestones you can ship and measure.

own merchandising for ccbp on and off app - home page assets, cross-sell placements, communication plans.

design and run campaigns (offers, cashback, reward mechanics) to drive adoption and repeat usage, optimizing spend for roI rather than just reach.

focus on reducing friction and building payment confidence — low-cost engagement over short-term yield maximization.

run a constant experimentation cadence (A/B/multivariate testing) to find growth inflection points, and productize what works into the core journey.

partner with product and data science teams to build personalization models (due-date prediction, smart nudges, next-best-card-to-pay) that increase throughput.

bring clear, data-backed narratives to cross-functional discussions (Marketing, Rewards, Product, Risk) to align on priorities and unblock execution.

What we’re looking for

4–7 years of experience in user growth/ category management roles, with prior ownership of high-frequency consumer transaction/payment categories or 3-5 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, growth strategy, corporate strategy, or fintech strategy roles.

data-driven mindset — comfortable analyzing data to form hypotheses, identify opportunities, and measure experiment success.

track record of driving growth initiatives end-to-end (ideation → execution → measurable impact) at a consumer-first company.

high ownership and bias for action in a fast-paced, ambiguous, agile environment.

strong program/project management skills - able to run multiple cross-functional initiatives (product, marketing, risk, ops) simultaneously with attention to detail.
